items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I was — Zan Stewart out here was doing an interview and he said, “We’ll take a picture for the magazine.”

ctx.x: At the house in Palm Springs. And he used to come into The Sands in Vegas and also the place Rimrocks in Palm Springs. He’d come in sometimes and just pass the group going into the lounge and say, “Hey Sam you’re blowing your ass off” or something like that. Anyhow we were in Palm Springs and we played a little thing for him, and he came out with this thing and he said, “Sam, I want you to see something.” So he came out with this box and I opened it and it’s a flute, like a wooden flute made in Rudelcard,…
What was it like to get record labels to record you? Has it been hard over the years?
